paras: Holcosus anomalus, also known commonly as Echternacht's ameiva, is a species of lizard in the family Teiidae. The species is endemic to Colombia.
H. anomalus is found in the Pacific lowlands of Colombia.
The preferred natural habitat of H. anomalus is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 500 m (1,600 ft).

Moderately large for its genus, H. anomalus may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 11 cm (4.3 in). The ventral scales on the chest are granular, a character which is unique in its genus and in its subfamily (Teiinae).
